protocol.experiment: local reranking and admission, no generated-answer accuracy claim
protocol.selection: one fresh SQAC question per previously unused article family
protocol.negative_scope: published impossible question restricted to its own source document
protocol.negative_limits: automatically translated SQuAD v2; not human Spanish adjudication

negative admission is not a false generated answer
